= 26

#### 120

#### 5

Total weight required
= 80 flagstones × 75 lb/flagstone
= 6 000 lb

Weight capacity per truck = 2 000 lb

Maximum whole flagstones per truck
= floor( 2 000 lb / 75 lb per stone )
= floor( 26.67 ) = 26 stones

Stones that can be moved with 3 trucks
= 3 × 26 = 78 stones < 80 stones

Hence 3 trucks are insufficient for whole stones.  
4 trucks are required, 3 trucks carrying 26 stones and the 4th carrying the remaining 2 stones.

By weight alone 6 000 lb / 2 000 lb per truck = 3.0 trucks.
